toegepas.rede_vinder: When one product is made from another raw material, 'uit' is the more natural Afrikaans preposition.
toegepas.fout: 'van olie gemaak' reads as made OF a material (English 'made from' copied); for a product refined out of a raw material Afrikaans naturally uses 'uit', as in 'wyn uit druiwe'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same meaning (petrol and diesel come from oil), the more natural preposition for a derived product, and it matches the paragraph's own 'uit plante gevorm'; no protected wording touched.
